## Study systems

::: {.content-card}
I conduct research in sharks and marine invertebrates.  These systems offer completely different windows into how marine organisms respond to environmental stress. 
::: 

::: {.content-card}
## Approaches and techinques 

My research integrates approaches across biological scales from molecules to organisms: 

- RNA-seq and transcriptomics
- Physiology 
- Respirometry
- Organismal performance measurements
- Modeling and integrative data analysis 
::: 

::: {.content-card}

Together, my research projects provide insights how marine organisms experience and respond to environmental stress across their lives.
